# The checks on the fast trampoline body read a listing that exists only when
# GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo is on: without it runtime.logosCgocallFast is not
# linked and the listing is empty. This script turns the experiment on and fails
# if any of the three tests skips or does not run.
[!cgo] skip 'needs cgo'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
go test -v -count=1 -run '^(TestFastcallNoClockInFastBody|TestFastcallStructure|TestFastcallOneTrampoline)$' cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallNoClockInFastBody'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallStructure'
stdout '--- PASS: TestFastcallOneTrampoline'
! stdout 'SKIP'
stdout '^ok\s+cmd/cgo/internal/testlogos'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/fastcallbody

go 1.27
